description: Table 3 is a text-only reference table (no axes, curves or images) laid out as two side-by-side "Number | Phase" blocks that map the numbered phase regions of Figure 6 to their phase assemblages, calculated for the Fe–C–Si–Mn–P–S–Al–O–N–Ti system with FactSage 8.2. Header row reads "Number  Phase  Number  Phase". Left block: 1 = L; 2 = L + Al2O3; 3 = L + Al2O3 + FCC; 4 = L + Al2O3 + AlN + FCC; 5 = L + Al2O3 + AlN + FCC + MnS; 6 = Al2O3 + AlN + FCC + MnS. Right block: 7 = L + Al2O3 + AlN; 8 = L + Al2O3 + AlN + BCC; 9 = L + Al2O3 + AlN + BCC + FCC; 10 = L + Al2O3 + AlN + BCC + FCC + MnS; 11 = Al2O3 + AlN + BCC + FCC + MnS. Al2O3 appears in every assemblage except the pure-liquid entry 1; AlN appears from entry 4 onward; MnS enters at entry 5; BCC only appears in entries 8–11; entry 6 is the first fully solid assemblage and entry 11 the most complex, with five solid phases. Read with the citing text, the table shows that rising Al content routes solidification of 2# and 3# through BCC and shrinks the FCC field. No numeric values are printed.
measured_quantities: number of coexisting phases per numbered region (count, 1-5)
phase assemblage identifier (L, Al2O3, AlN, BCC, FCC, MnS)

observations.observation: The table header row reads 'Number', 'Phase', 'Number', 'Phase', i.e. two side-by-side number-to-phase lists covering 11 numbered entries.
Entry 1 is single-phase 'L' (liquid); Al2O3 first appears in entry 2 ('L + Al2O3').
AlN first appears at entry 4 ('L + Al2O3 + AlN + FCC'); MnS first appears at entry 5 ('L + Al2O3 + AlN + FCC + MnS').
The BCC phase occurs only in entries 8, 9, 10 and 11, all of which are on the right-hand half of the table.
Entry 6 ('Al2O3 + AlN + FCC + MnS') is the first entry with no liquid phase; entry 11 ('Al2O3 + AlN + BCC + FCC + MnS') contains five solid phases and no liquid.
Al2O3 is present in every phase assemblage listed except the fully liquid entry 1.
The caption states that the phase composition entries correspond to the numbered regions in Figure 6.
The citing text states that the solidification route of the 1# sample is L → L + FCC → FCC.
The citing text states that the 2# and 3# samples solidify via L → L + BCC → L + BCC + FCC → L + FCC → FCC and L → L + BCC → L + BCC + FCC → BCC + FCC → FCC respectively.
The citing text attributes the BCC-passing solidification route of 2# and 3# to increasing Al content and states that the region where the FCC phase exists decreases.
The citing text states that the phase diagram module of FactSage 8.2 was used to calculate the Fe–C–Si–Mn–P–S–Al–O–N–Ti system, which is the source of the phase lists in this table.

subfigures.description: Left half of the table: rows 1–6 with columns 'Number' and 'Phase' — 1 = L; 2 = L + Al2O3; 3 = L + Al2O3 + FCC; 4 = L + Al2O3 + AlN + FCC; 5 = L + Al2O3 + AlN + FCC + MnS; 6 = Al2O3 + AlN + FCC + MnS.

Right half of the table: rows 7–11 with columns 'Number' and 'Phase' — 7 = L + Al2O3 + AlN; 8 = L + Al2O3 + AlN + BCC; 9 = L + Al2O3 + AlN + BCC + FCC; 10 = L + Al2O3 + AlN + BCC + FCC + MnS; 11 = Al2O3 + AlN + BCC + FCC + MnS.
